rationale: As a premium photography studio's internal tool, it needs to feel exclusive, precise, and highly functional. A dark, high-contrast 'Swiss/Technical' theme acts as a command center for the founder, allowing bookings to stand out visually without distraction.

own_confirmed.description: High contrast, solid white block for immediate visibility of the member's own bookings.

anonymous_booked.description: Subtle striped pattern or dark grey block indicating unavailability without giving details.

pending_request.description: Warm amber warning color for requests awaiting admin approval.

denied_request.description: Muted, dark red for denied requests.

rules: Headings must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight).
Timestamps and technical data (like Google Calendar IDs) must use JetBrains Mono.

navigation.mobile: Fixed bottom navigation bar (h-16 or h-20), applying pb-24 to main container.
navigation.desktop: Fixed left sidebar (w-64), main content takes remaining width.

spacing_scale.generous: p-6 md:p-8 lg:p-12 for main section padding.
spacing_scale.dense: p-2 gap-2 for calendar grid cells.

grid_modes.dashboard: MODE B (Control Room): grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Strict hierarchy, tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).

components.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Customize to be flat with 1px border-neutral-800, focus:ring-1 focus:ring-white focus:border-white.

buttons.primary: bg-white text-black hover:bg-neutral-200 font-medium rounded-none or rounded-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-neutral-800 text-white hover:bg-neutral-900 rounded-none or rounded-sm

modals_and_sheets.desktop: Shadcn Dialog. Glassmorphism backdrop (bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xl), solid dark surface (bg-neutral-950), 1px border (border-neutral-800).
modals_and_sheets.mobile: Shadcn Drawer (bottom sheet) for booking forms. Pull tab at top, snaps to content height.

components.calendar: Custom grid implementation using pure HTML/Tailwind for structural layout to allow absolute positioning of multi-hour bookings. Month/Week/Day toggle uses Shadcn Tabs.
components.notifications: Shadcn DropdownMenu on desktop, Drawer on mobile, triggered by a Bell icon.
components.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='approve-booking-button').

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Buttons translate-y-[-1px] with subtle brightness increase. Explicit text color on hover (hover:text-black).
motion_and_interaction.focus: High contrast ring: focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-white focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-black

login_background.description: Dark, abstract camera lens close-up for the auth/login entry point overlay. Use with bg-black/60 overlay.

icons.style: Use 1.5px stroke width for a precise, technical look.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build standard JS files (.js/.jsx), NO TYPESCRIPT (.tsx).
Start with the unauthenticated Auth/Login screen using the provided background image.
Implement the Layout wrapper that switches between Mobile Bottom Nav and Desktop Sidebar based on viewport (Tailwind hidden/md:flex classes).
Develop the Calendar Views (Month/Week/Day) with a focus on data density and clear visual semantics for 'Own Confirmed', 'Booked' (Anonymous), and 'Pending' states.
Ensure the booking form uses a Bottom Sheet (Drawer) on mobile and a Modal (Dialog) on desktop.
Include 'data-testid' on ALL buttons, inputs, tabs, and interactive elements.

Use standard Shadcn components installed in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/ but override their styles to match the 'Swiss Dark' aesthetic (flat, 1px borders, sharp or slightly rounded corners, no soft shadows).
